01 · WHO WE ARE

About Volt & Line

Volt & Line is a licensed electrical service for Metro Manila homes and small businesses — a mobile crew that comes to you, not a showroom you have to find.

We do the electrical work most outfits either won't touch or won't explain: rewiring old houses, upgrading tired panels, chasing down the fault behind a tripping breaker, and making sure it's all safe and to code before we leave. Everything we do is wired to the Philippine Electrical Code and documented where it needs to be.

No storefront means less overhead and more honesty — you get a licensed electrician at your door, a clear quote, and work that passes inspection. Simple as that.

02 · WHAT WE DO

Electrical services

SVC/01

Wiring & rewiring

New circuits and full rewires for older homes — safe, tidy and to the Philippine Electrical Code.

SVC/02

Panel & breaker upgrades

Upgrading old fuse boxes and panels to modern breakers sized for how you actually use power today.

SVC/03

Lighting installation

Downlights, fixtures, outdoor and accent lighting installed cleanly and switched sensibly.

SVC/04

Fault-finding

Tracking down tripping breakers, dead sockets and mystery faults — diagnosed properly, then fixed.

SVC/05

Outlets & aircon circuits

Extra outlets, dedicated aircon lines and correctly rated circuits for heavy appliances.

SVC/06

Safety inspections

Full electrical safety checks and surge protection, with documentation for sale, rental or peace of mind.

07 · FAQ

Questions

Do you have a shop I can visit? +
No — Volt & Line is a mobile service, so there's no showroom to visit. We come to your home or site anywhere in our Metro Manila service area. Just call or message and we'll arrange a visit.
Are your electricians licensed? +
Yes. Work is carried out or supervised by licensed electrical practitioners and wired to the Philippine Electrical Code. We're happy to confirm credentials before any job.
How do I get a quote? +
Call or message with your location and what you need — a description or a photo helps. For small jobs we can estimate on the spot; for larger work we assess on-site and quote before starting.
Do you handle emergencies? +
We prioritise urgent electrical faults — tripping breakers, burning smells, dead circuits and safety hazards. Call us and we'll get to you as soon as we can within the service area.
Which areas do you cover? +
We serve Quezon City and much of Metro Manila, including Manila, Makati, Pasig, Mandaluyong, San Juan, Marikina, Caloocan, Parañaque and Taguig. Not sure if you're in range? Call and ask.
Do you pull permits and issue certificates? +
For work that requires it, we handle the electrical permit process and provide documentation on completion, so your wiring is compliant and properly certified.
